name: M
source:
Author of the bestseller "MUSE" which became a social phenomenon in the United States.
His/her age, gender and history is shrouded in mystery, (s)he is a masked writer.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/magauta/index.html#2]official website[/url]]
